question.wording: Does this employee elect to include nontaxable combat pay (Form W-2 box 12 code Q) in earned income for the earned income credit?

options.label: Yes — elect; it goes on line 1i

default.because: Nontaxable combat pay is not elected into earned income unless a preparer says so

citation.wording: If you elect to include your nontaxable combat pay in your earned income when figuring the EIC, enter the amount on line 1i.
